name: optimize-unattended
description:
Iterative metric-driven optimization with autonomous (NEVER STOP) experimentation. setup → metric-script validation → baseline (cost projection) → autonomous experimentation loop (no batch checkpoints) → synthesis → code-review → completion (squash from optimize.best_commit, MR/PR with leaderboard).

Autonomous twin of `optimize`. The experimentation step enters fully autonomous implementation mode by design — not a generic property of `mode:implementation` steps. Designed for overnight / unattended runs; loop terminates only on `_func_check_termination` (max_iterations / max_duration / regression_halt_n / target_metric) or manual interrupt (`protocol_abort`). All non-experimentation sub-protocols are shared verbatim with the `optimize` protocol (D3 hybrid).

Example: protocol_start(protocol_name="optimize-unattended") to run an overnight prompt-tuning sweep with max_iterations=200, max_duration="8h" — loop runs to termination without user gates.

steps.name: setup
steps.description: Interactive metric elicitation; persists settings to optimize-state.json; auto-creates task file + branch + issue
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] User has approved metric definition, scope, batch size, and termination conditions.
- [ ] Task file is composed and optimize-state.json fields are populated.
- [ ] Pass args including required {metric_command, metric_parser, metric_direction, metric_monotonic, task, branch, task_content} plus any optional overrides to protocol_advance.

steps.name: metric-script
steps.description: Author/refine the measurement script; validate via double-run stability gate
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] Metric script exists, runs cleanly, and the parser yields a float.
- [ ] Two consecutive runs are within stability_threshold_pct (default 5%).
If the validator fails: fix the script and call protocol_advance again — the validator re-runs from this step's post_funcs.

steps.name: baseline
steps.description: Capture baseline metric on HEAD; project total cost from real timing
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] Baseline metric captured; baseline_wall_clock_s and optimize.baseline_commit recorded.
- [ ] Cost projection presented to the user.
- [ ] If both max_iterations and max_duration are null (unbounded mode): include args["unbounded_acknowledged"]="i-accept-unbounded-cost" in the next protocol_advance.

steps.name: experimentation
steps.description: Autonomous hypothesis loop: each iteration commits one hypothesis, runs the metric, logs a TSV row; loop runs to termination without per-iteration user gates.
steps.end:
The loop ends when:
- [ ] _func_check_termination returns terminate=true (max_iterations / max_duration / regression_halt / target_reached), OR a manual interrupt (protocol_abort).
- [ ] optimize.best_commit and optimize.best_metric are recorded in task frontmatter for the synthesis and completion steps.

steps.name: synthesis
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] Findings written to the task work log.
- [ ] policy_compliance_audit results (metric_gaming_flags, if any) propagated as advisory data into the next step's prompt.
This step never blocks advance.

steps.name: code-review
steps.description: Spec-compliance review + code-quality review on the cumulative diff baseline..best_commit
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] Spec compliance review passed — SPEC_REVIEW: PASSED sentinel recorded.
- [ ] Code review passes with zero critical issues.
- [ ] Final passing review appended to the task work log under '# Code Review:'.
- [ ] Advance summary contains verification evidence or 'no-verification-applicable: <reason>'.

steps.name: completion
steps.description: User confirms; engine squashes from optimize.best_commit and creates MR/PR with leaderboard
steps.end:
Advance when:
- [ ] User has confirmed.
completion_dispatch routes to _completion_optimize: squash from optimize.best_commit (provider chain) or one of merge_local/push_pr/keep/discard (disabled-provider menu). MR/PR description includes the sorted markdown leaderboard from results.tsv.
